name: bZx iToken empty-pool donation rounding

classification.summary: After the iYFI pool was emptied the attacker minted 5 wei of iYFI, donated YFI straight to the pool to inflate its price per share, and used the rounded-up collateral value to borrow out the iETH and iWBTC pools while still redeeming the 5 wei.

sources.note: onchain review: iYFI 0x7f3fe9d492a9a60aebb06d82cba23c6f32cad10b created 2020-09-03T00:36:30Z by 0xb7f72028d9b502dc871c444363a7ac5a52546608, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events between creation and the incident, age from deployment (1185 days). Loss ~$208K per the PoC header, taken as ETH and WBTC across two txs; only the first is recorded.

delegatecall-target review (callTracer + prestateTracer on the exploit tx, then eth_getStorageAt over [creation block, incident block]): like the other bZx iTokens this is a setTarget proxy that emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded event; the exploit tx DELEGATECALLs 0x7f3fe9d4...d10b -> 0x624f7f89414011b276c60ea2337bfba936d1cbbe for every selector (mint, burn, transferFrom, borrow), and prestateTracer confirms that address is read from storage slot 20 (target_ in the verified LoanTokenLogic layout). Binary-searching slot 20 between the creation block 10785097 and the incident block 18695729 gives eight logic swaps: 0x11ba2b39 at deployment, then 0xbab2cb0d (2020-09-03), 0x1e9682d8 (2020-09-04), 0x7f5f0f68 (2020-09-13), 0xd172991b (2020-09-13), 0xfb772316 (2020-11-16), 0xd154ee49 (2021-11-15), 0x528d205b (2022-05-13) and 0x624f7f89414011b276c60ea2337bfba936d1cbbe at block 16275583, 2022-12-27T10:47:47Z, unchanged across 60 samples to the incident. The exploited donation-rounding code was 339.6 days old, not the 1185 days measured from deployment - the same setTarget mechanism already corrected on the iETH row in this file
